INSERT IGNORE INTO t_analytics_event (event_id, open_id, session_id, event_type, page_path, business_id, source_scene, channel, app_version, client_time, received_time) VALUES
(#{item.eventId}, #{item.openId}, #{item.sessionId}, #{item.eventType}, #{item.pagePath}, #{item.businessId}, #{item.sourceScene}, #{item.channel}, #{item.appVersion}, #{item.clientTime}, #{item.receivedTime})
INSERT INTO t_analytics_visitor (open_id, first_visit_at, last_visit_at) VALUES (#{openId}, #{visitTime}, #{visitTime}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_visit_at = VALUES(last_visit_at)

INSERT INTO t_analytics_visitor_day (stat_date, open_id, first_visit_at, last_visit_at, pv_count) VALUES (#{statDate}, #{openId}, #{visitTime}, #{visitTime}, #{pvIncrement}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_visit_at = VALUES(last_visit_at), pv_count = pv_count + VALUES(pv_count)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.open_id) AS uv, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_type = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pv, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_type = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS started_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_type = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS completed_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_type = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS share_count, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_report r WHERE r.deleted = 0 AND r.generated_at >= #{since}) + (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_pair_report pr WHERE pr.deleted = 0 AND pr.generated_at >= #{since}) AS report_count FROM t_analytics_event e WHERE e.received_time >= #{since}

SELECT DATE(received_time) AS stat_date, COUNT(DISTINCT open_id) AS uv, SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pv, SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS started_count, SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_count FROM t_analytics_event WHERE received_time >= #{since} GROUP BY DATE(received_time) ORDER BY stat_date ASC

SELECT t.id AS test_id, t.test_name, COUNT(a.id) AS started_count, SUM(CASE WHEN a.answer_status IN (2, 3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_count, CASE WHEN COUNT(a.id) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND( SUM(CASE WHEN a.answer_status IN (2, 3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(a.id), 2) END AS completion_rate FROM t_test t LEFT JOIN t_test_version v ON v.test_id = t.id AND v.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN t_answer_session a ON a.version_id = v.id AND a.deleted = 0 AND a.create_date >= #{since} WHERE t.deleted = 0 GROUP BY t.id, t.test_name ORDER BY started_count DESC, t.id DESC
